name: Saas Toh Len De Bey - Aakash Gupta
visual_description: Standup comedian Aakash Gupta holding a microphone on stage, glancing sideways in disbelief with the caption 'saas toh len de bey' at the bottom.
usage_context: Used to express feeling overwhelmed, rushed, or demanded for follow-up results before even catching one's breath.

example.top_text:
Completed graduation today
Relatives 5 minutes later: Shaadi kab kar rahe ho?

text_areas.description: Situation or rushed demand causing overwhelm
